deathtouch: Core exposes keyword and lethal primitive; GUI explicitly turns lethal threshold into 1. New core validator must own this.
first_strike_double_strike: Core-owned by Combat.dealDamageThisPhase and two PhaseHandler damage steps. Assignment legality must be evaluated separately for each step.
infect_wither: Damage-result semantics remain core-owned. Infect changes player damage result to poison and GUI uses it for display/defender lethal heuristics; assignment validator must not treat prevention/replacement result prediction as permission to reduce blocker lethal.

prevention_replacement: Assignment occurs before actual simultaneous damage. CR 702.19b says effects that change damage actually dealt do not reduce lethal assignment. GameAction damage processing remains after assignment.
state_mutation_boundary: Current returned allocation map is committed directly. This is the decisive missing independent validation boundary.
trample: Core detects trample and defender, but GUI/AI currently compute key legal amounts; current CR 702.19b also requires considering same-step damage assigned by other creatures.
